files.README.md:
# Thorneybank Foundry - melting shift journal

The foundry's two induction furnaces melt iron for the day's castings, and the
furnace house writes one line to logs/melting-shift.log for every run:

    <UTC time> RUN batch=<id> furnace=<F-1|F-2> heats=<n> charged=<n> tapped=<n>

`heats` is how many times the run fired its furnace, `charged` is the tonnes of
scrap and returns put into the furnace and `tapped` is the tonnes of iron poured
out of it, the melt loss being what stayed behind. The shift closes with a line
that counts every run above it and the heats they fired.
